full_name: Fei Yan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Radcliffe-Harvard Yenching Institute Fellow Tsinghua University (China)
bio: Fei Yan is an associate professor of sociology at Tsinghua University who specializes in political sociology and historical sociology, with a particular focus on how collective injustice motivates political protests and how institutional changes impact the identity of movement participants, ultimately altering the political orientations of social movements.
